claim: On January 16, 2024 Amazon EKS made extended support for Kubernetes versions a full release. Extended Kubernetes version support lets you stay at a specific Kubernetes version for longer than 14 months.
question: When did EKS extended Kubernetes version support get its full release?

values.display: Full release: Amazon EKS Extended Support

note: FRESHNESS.md says 2024-04-01; the document history says full release 2024-01-16 (preview 2023-10-04). The history row wins.
